## Motivation DeepSeek-V4.1 sparse prefill dequantizes the cached compressed KV into a bf16 workspace on every step. On a prefix-cache hit this cost grows with the cached prefix. The existing direct path (FlashMLA reading the FP8 paged cache) costs per query row instead, but is slower on cold chunks. Choosing the path per step from the batch shape makes long-prefix hits about 6% faster and leaves cold prefill unchanged. Direct reads on prefill also reach batch sizes where FlashMLA's schedule precompute fails to launch: its 48 KiB guard ignores the kernel's static shared memory, so on a 152-SM GPU batches of 2,212–2,214 rows pass the guard and fail. ```bash python3 -m sglang.launch_server \ --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --trust-remote-code \ --tp 4 --ep-size 4 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 \ --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 \ --max-running-requests 64 --chunked-prefill-size 8192 python3 repro.py hit 65536 16 # repro.py below ```
repro.py (Python standard library) ```python # usage: python3 repro.py cold|hit TOKENS CONCURRENCY import json, os, random, statistics, sys, time, urllib.request from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor mode, length, concurrency = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]) url = os.environ.get("URL", "http://127.0.0.1:30000") + "/generate" rng = random.Random(20261009) prefix = [rng.randrange(1000, 120000) for _ in range(length)] def request(ids): body = {"input_ids": ids, "stream": True, "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0, "ignore_eos": True, "max_new_tokens": 8 if mode == "hit" else 1}} req = urllib.request.Request(url, json.dumps(body).encode(), {"Content-Type": "application/json"}) start = time.perf_counter() first = None with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=300) as response: for line in response: if line.startswith(b"data:") and first is None: first = time.perf_counter() - start return first def wave(): prompts = [] for _ in range(concurrency): new = [rng.randrange(1000, 120000) for _ in range(1024 if mode == "hit" else length)] prompts.append(prefix + new if mode == "hit" else new) with ThreadPoolExecutor(concurrency) as pool: return list(pool.map(request, prompts)) if mode == "hit": request(prefix) for _ in range(2): wave() start = time.perf_counter() times = [value for _ in range(5) for value in wave()] elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start print("TTFT p50 %.2f ms" % (statistics.median(times) * 1000)) if mode == "cold": print("input %.0f tok/s" % (5 * concurrency * length / elapsed)) ```
## Modifications - Read the FP8 cache directly when the batch's cached prefix is at least *k* × its extend rows (batch totals): *k* = 5 on eager steps, 8 inside breakable prefill CUDA graphs. Defaults apply on SM100 only, where they were measured; other platforms default to 0 (unchanged behavior). Override with `SGLANG_DSV4_SPARSE_PREFILL_DIRECT_PREFIX_PER_ROW` / `..._GRAPH`; 0 keeps the workspace. - **Behavior change:** on SM100, forcing the workspace with `SGLANG_OPT_FLASHMLA_SPARSE_PREFILL=1` now also needs both thresholds set to 0. - The per-step choice lives in `DSV4Metadata`. Sparse page indices are built only when a step can read direct (always inside breakable prefill graphs, which reuse one captured indexer). - `sched_meta_fits()` counts the kernel's static shared memory, so oversized schedules take the existing fallback. Related: #40429 adds the same size check without the static part. ## Accuracy Tests - Unit tests on GB300: 90 passed (+45 subtests), covering threshold boundaries, overrides, SM100-only defaults, and FlashMLA launches around the shared-memory limit derived from the GPU's SM count. `test_sparse_prefill_direct.py` runs on CPU CI (22 passed). - Serving, same node, launch above (GSM8K: first 200, 5-shot, greedy; needles: 32K ×20 + 64K ×10): | | main | this PR | |---|---|---| | GSM8K cold / prefix hit | 197 / 196 | 197 / 198 | | needles cold / hit / hit | 30/30 ×3 | 30/30 ×3 | - First-token top-20 KL on needle hits vs main: median 5.5e-7; p90 and max within main's run-to-run range. ## Speed Tests and Profiling 4×GB300, TP4/EP4, DSpark, launch above; order main → PR → PR → main, mean of two runs per arm. Hits append 1K tokens to a cached prefix. | point | main | this PR | change | |---|---|---|---| | cold 8K c8, input tok/s | 43,060 | 43,890 | +1.9% | | cold 32K c8, input tok/s | 44,378 | 44,082 | −0.7% | | hit 7K c1, TTFT p50 ms | 203.0 | 191.0 | −5.9% | | hit 16K c1, TTFT p50 ms | 201.3 | 188.9 | −6.1% | | hit 64K c1, TTFT p50 ms | 207.5 | 194.7 | −6.2% | | hit 16K c16, TTFT p50 ms | 587.0 | 551.0 | −6.1% | | decode c32, step ms | 15.23 | 15.05 | −1.2% | Cold prefill stays on the workspace (changes within run-to-run spread). With a 1,536-row breakable prefill graph (threshold 8), 16K/32K/64K hits are 15–21% faster at c1 and 7K hits stay on the workspace; this was measured on a development branch with bounded SWA replay enabled. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #40282855841](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40282855841) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #40282855705](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40282855705) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #40282855798](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40282855798)

+"""Routing boundaries for sparse-prefill direct cache reads."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention import deepseek_v4_backend as backend_module
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend import (
+    DeepseekV4AttnBackend,
+    _prefill_reads_fp8_direct,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner_backend_utils.breakable_cuda_graph import (
+    context as bcg_context,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "prefix,rows,in_graph,expected",
+    [
+        (None, [1024], False, False),
+        ([0], [8192], False, False),
+        ([4095], [819, 1], False, False),
+        ([4096], [819, 1], False, False),
+        ([5000], [1000], False, True),
+        ([4999], [1000], False, False),
+        ([7168], [1024], False, True),
+        ([7168], [1024], True, False),
+        ([8000], [1000], True, True),
+        ([7999], [1000], True, False),
+        ([10000, 0], [1000, 1000], False, True),
+        ([9999, 0], [1000, 1000], False, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_prefix_per_query_row(prefix, rows, in_graph, expected):
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(extend_prefix_lens_cpu=prefix, extend_seq_lens_cpu=rows)
+    with (
+        envs.SGLANG_OPT_FLASHMLA_SPARSE_PREFILL.override(True),
+        envs.SGLANG_DSV4_SPARSE_PREFILL_DIRECT_PREFIX_PER_ROW.override(5),
+        envs.SGLANG_DSV4_SPARSE_PREFILL_DIRECT_PREFIX_PER_ROW_GRAPH.override(8),
+    ):
+        assert _prefill_reads_fp8_direct(batch, in_prefill_graph=in_graph) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("in_graph", [False, True])
+def test_zero_threshold_and_explicit_direct_override(in_graph):
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(extend_prefix_lens_cpu=[65536], extend_seq_lens_cpu=[1024])
+    with (
+        envs.SGLANG_OPT_FLASHMLA_SPARSE_PREFILL.override(True),
+        envs.SGLANG_DSV4_SPARSE_PREFILL_DIRECT_PREFIX_PER_ROW.override(0),
+        envs.SGLANG_DSV4_SPARSE_PREFILL_DIRECT_PREFIX_PER_ROW_GRAPH.override(0),
+    ):
+        assert not _prefill_reads_fp8_direct(batch, in_prefill_graph=in_graph)
+        with envs.SGLANG_OPT_FLASHMLA_SPARSE_PREFILL.override(False):
+            assert _prefill_reads_fp8_direct(batch, in_prefill_graph=in_graph)

+def _first_unfit_batch(num_sm_parts: int) -> int:

+    b = 1
+    while sched_meta_fits(batch_size=b, num_sm_parts=num_sm_parts):

+

+    backend._maybe_precompute_flashmla_sched_meta(
